newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BOURSE TO DISCUSS TRADING MODERNISATION.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BOURSE TO DISCUSS TRADING MODERNISATION.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange council meeting this week will consider trading moderniasation plans, including the introduction of continuous trading for the most liquid stocks, a council member said on Monday.
"The council meeting on Thursday will consider a modrnisation plan of the trading system," Karlis Krastinsh, a member of the bourse council, told Reuters.
"The meeting might also discuss the introduction of continuous trade for a number of the most liquid stocks," Krastinsh said.
"The bourse's software AS-400 is being upgraded to provide dealers with an on-line price quotation and trading system, initially at least for the three or five most active stocks," Krastinsh said.
The timing of these innovations will also be discussed by the council.
The bourse has already embarked on making the current trading system more flexible. Earlier this year it adjusted regulations to make the price fixing or reopening longer.
